fact: IIDIA and ASIN launched a Regional Innovation and Digital Technology Lab in Cotonou to develop the first voice-to-voice AI model in the Fon language, with a functional prototype due within 9 months, trained on NVIDIA A100/H100 GPUs, with Gates Foundation support.

IIDIA and Benin's ASIN launched in Cotonou the development of a Fon-language voice-to-voice AI model, with a prototype due in nine months, trained on NVIDIA A100/H100 GPUs, supported by the Gates Foundation.

The ministry says GPT.BJ, a chatbot developed by the Benin Agency for Information Systems and Digital, was launched in 2023 during the second Digital Entrepreneurship and Artificial Intelligence Fair.
Levellers says ASIN built GPT BJ, a public-service chatbot trained on Benin's legal and administrative texts; it gives no date, so the document's date is used.
Benin's Council of Ministers approved a pilot in which each Innobox hub (Parakou, Porto-Novo) will help collect datasets in national languages for AI applications.

Benin's J'aime ma langue project recorded 700 hours of Fongbe speech from 2,507 people in all 12 departments, and a speech recognition system built on it makes four times fewer errors than the best existing model; 19 voice services were demonstrated, per Matin Libre.
